name: Tiszarád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszarád: a white and red shield with ears of grain, a church and a sabre, with red and blue mantling, below a scroll inscribed TISZARÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszarád arms with mantling and scroll
